nodes.subtreeText: Ruff supports over 900 lint rules , many of which are inspired by popular tools like Flake8, isort, pyupgrade, and others. Regardless of the rule's origin, Ruff re-implements every rule in Rust as a first-party feature.

nodes.subtreeText: By default, Ruff enables rules from the F , E , B , UP , and RUF categories, as well as many more, omitting any stylistic rules that overlap with the use of a formatter, like ruff format or Black .
